verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own materials say you can spin up thousands of concurrent browser sessions, create and control sessions programmatically, and pull data from websites. Together these cover the core of large-scale concurrent scraping. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of concurrency limits, quotas and plan tiers; independent or hands-on corroboration of scale and reliability under load.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can spin up many concurrent scraping sessions to gather data at scale
